communications.summary: Ordinary LLD-09 implementation is complete in the working tree: source configuration/settings, owned identities and collision/content review, ordinary/targeted/Deep Scan processing and historical coverage/reconstruction, typed proposal/owner integration, SR/RFC terminal/reversal, orphan retention and independent housekeeping, verified MSG publication, bounded queries and summaries, static transport/runtime composition, schedule/coalescing/per-source reader serialization, runtime migration 16 and all 100 scenario bindings. Ordinary implementation received a byte-bound local certificate after second review and an adapter privacy fix. Complete local suite passed 1955 tests; schema/compile/wheel/privacy checks pass. PFF adapter architecture is implemented with typed deterministic doubles and an explicit UNSUPPORTED state without a release bridge. Native physical C001-C012 certification is deferred under the accepted LLD09-PFF-RELEASE-PIN and LLD09-GOLDEN-CORPUS-FREEZE gates. Implementation and local evidence are committed at 6cf3d742f1c933087ede982f7b107576b90415af; supported-matrix remote CI promotion remains pending.
